description: This Java class 'UserService' provides user management functionalities such as creating, reading, and updating users within a microservices architecture, integrating with Keycloak for authentication and a banking core service for user verification.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class managing user operations including creation, retrieval, and update, integrating with Keycloak and banking services.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user after verifying email and identification, interacts with Keycloak and banking services, and saves user data.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users, enriching data with Keycloak user info.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user status and enables Keycloak user account if approved.
